transactions.desc: The Los Angeles Angels traded C Logan O'Hoppe to the Texas Rangers.
The Los Angeles Angels traded RHP Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers.
Atlanta optioned Smith-Shawver to Triple-A Gwinnett after Wednesday's game against the Mets.
The Angels reinstated d'Arnaud (foot) from the injured list Wednesday.
The Dodgers designated Barnes for assignment Wednesday.
The Dodgers activated Diaz (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday.
The Red Sox recalled Sogard from Triple-A Worcester on Wednesday.
The Twins recalled Gray from Triple-A St. Paul on Wednesday.
The Cubs selected Woodford's contract from Triple-A Iowa on Wednesday.
The Cubs designated Wantz for assignment on Wednesday.
The Astros reinstated Wesneski (elbow) from the injured list ahead of his start Wednesday against the Angels.
The Astros optioned Ullola to Triple-A Sugar Land on Wednesday.
Krook elected to enter free agency Wednesday after declining his outright assignment from the Nationals to Triple-A Rochester.
The Nationals optioned Schultz to Triple-A Rochester on Wednesday.
The Royals recalled Rave from Triple-A Omaha on Wednesday.
The Pirates released Santana on Wednesday, Mark Feinsand of MLB.com reports.
The Rays recalled Roycroft from Triple-A Durham on Wednesday.
The Guardians optioned Espino to Triple-A Columbus on Wednesday.
The Padres designated Waldron for assignment Wednesday.
The Padres reinstated Estrada (knee) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday.
The Angels released Manoah on Wednesday.
The Brewers optioned Stallings to Triple-A Nashville on Wednesday.
The Brewers selected Pannone's contract from Triple-A Nashville on Wednesday, Todd Rosiak of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
The Blue Jays recalled Dallas from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday, Mitch Bannon of The Athletic reports.
The Blue Jays optioned Van Eyk to Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday, Mitch Bannon of The Athletic reports.
The Nationals reinstated Williams (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday.
The Pirates optioned Mattson to Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday, Kevin Gorman of TribLive.com reports.
The Pirates optioned Eisert to Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday, Jason Mackey of MLB.com reports.
The Pirates recalled Barco from Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday, Jason Mackey of MLB.com reports.
The Pirates optioned Callihan to Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday, Danny Demilio of PittsburghBaseballNow.com reports.
